english_classification.chapter_title: The Seventh, concerning the Five Fathers
english_classification.chapter_note: A well-preserved emanation hierarchy teaching: five fathers, each summoning three powers. The substrate is dominant in ¶2-12, forming a clean systematic sequence. Editorial fatigue is clearly visible from ¶13 onward, where the editors increasingly overlay institutional vocabulary (churches, elect, catechumens) onto the emanation scheme. The substrate identifications survive even in the second half, but the functional descriptions shift from cosmos→cosmos to cosmos→institution. The emanation pattern language ('after the pattern of') is structural substrate. A gospel citation (John 8:38) intrudes at ¶15. The chapter closes with a standard beatitude formula.
